snippet.title: The Taj Mahal Cost Him His Hands #TajMahal #Shorts
snippet.description:
A dramatic paper-diorama retelling of the legend of Ahmad, the architect placed in charge of building the Taj Mahal—and the brutal price that followed his greatest achievement.

A short story about skill, power, and what happens when being irreplaceable becomes dangerous.
